description: One period's sales tax return laid out by the lines of the real form (GST34 lines 101 to 115, BC PST boxes A to K, CDTFA-401 lines, ...), with the books' figures, the commission or vendor discount, local tax by jurisdiction, exempt sales by reason (exemptByReason: the exemption certificate's reasonCode and reasonText, NOT_SPECIFIED for untaxed sales no certificate covers) and what the return comes to (netAmount: owing when positive, a refund when negative). It is an estimate to copy onto the form, not tax advice: say so when you quote it. Filing and paying are done in Mobile Accounting by a person.

bookId.description: The set of books, from list_books.

periodStart.description: The period's first day, yyyy-MM-dd, from sales_tax_returns.
